void vm_setProcessor(Vm_Processor_T processor,char *name)

{
  if (processor == (Vm_Processor_T)0x0) {
    if (vm_confEnableJit == 0) {
      name = "regular";
      processor = vm_regularProcessor;
    }
    else {
      name = "jit";
      processor = vm_jitProcessor;
    }
  }
  if (processor != vm_processor) {
    vm_ctrlFlags = vm_ctrlFlags | 0x20;
    vm_processorName = name;
    vm_processor = processor;
  }
  return;
}
